basic_details.job_title: CCI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 12 PPS, Office Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) is filling 12 posts on deputation on foreign service terms basis, for three years subject to satisfactory performance. The pay ranges from Level 10 (Rs.56100-177500) to Level 13A (Rs. 131100-216600) under the 7th CPC. Only employees of the All India Services or Central Civil Services, or of autonomous organisations, regulatory authorities, universities or academic or research institutions of the Central or State Governments may apply. The posts are Director (Eco), Joint Director (FA), Deputy Director (Eco), Deputy Director (FA), Assistant Director (CS)

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications by CCI.

The pre-revised pay scales printed there are also given.

how_to_apply: Applications are submitted offline only, through the applicant's employer. They must reach CCI by 24 December 2026 (5:00 PM).
Fill in the application in the prescribed pro-forma at Annexure-III. Write your name in block letters and paste a copy of a passport-size photograph in the box provided.
Submit a separate application for each post you want to apply for.

Complete item 12 by comparing the essential and desirable qualifications and experience with your own. Where a qualification has been treated as equivalent, name the authority that treated it as equivalent.

List your employment history in chronological order (item 13). If you need more space, use a separate sheet in the same format, signed by you. Also give any experience of handling investigation or enforcement of economic or regulatory law, or experience in Competition Law, with the number of years (item 14).
Sign the declaration. It states that your Curriculum Vitae, supported by documents, will also be assessed by the Selection Committee.
Get the certificate on the last page of the form completed, signed and sealed by your Employer/Head of office/Forwarding authority.

Have the application forwarded through proper channel, with all the documents listed below, to: Deputy Director (HR), Competition Commission of India, 9th Floor, Office Block-1, Kidwai Nagar (East), New Delhi-110023.
Application in the Annexure-III pro-forma, with a copy of a passport-size photograph pasted on it

Attested copies of up-to-date APARs for the last five years, or the CR/APAR dossier in original. Photocopies of ACRs/APARs must be attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Govt. of India or above.

Employer's certificate confirming four things: no vigilance, disciplinary or criminal case is pending or contemplated; the applicant's integrity; that no major or minor penalty was imposed in the last ten years, or a list of such penalties; and that the cadre controlling authority has no objection to the applicant being considered
For applicants not in the Central Government pay scales: the equivalence of their pay scale with the Central Government's pay scales, with supporting documents
important_instructions: Applications forwarded conditionally by the employer, or received without the prescribed documents and the employer's certificate, will be summarily rejected. Applications received after 24 December 2026 (5:00 PM) will not be considered. The Commission takes no responsibility for any delay in receipt of applications or for their loss in postal transit. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. In the employer's certificate, the employer confirms that the candidate will be relieved immediately if selected.

content_sections.heading: About CCI
content_sections.text: The Competition Commission of India (भारतीय प्रतिस्पर्धा आयोग) has its office at Office Block-1, 9th Floor, Kidwai Nagar (East), New Delhi – 110 023 (Tel: 011-24664100, Fax: 011-20815022). It also has a Regional Office in Kolkata, where one of the Office Manager (CS) posts is based. The Office Memorandum was issued by its HR Division.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: CCI is filling 12 posts: 5 professional posts and 7 administrative posts. The vacancies are liable to change without notice, and the Commission reserves the right not to fill any or all of them. *One post of Office Manager (CS) is for posting at Regional Office Kolkata. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be employees of the All India Services, the Central Civil Services, or autonomous organisations, regulatory authorities, universities or academic or research institutions etc. of the Central or State Governments. Their services must be able to be spared immediately on selection. The age limit and the other eligibility conditions in Annexures I and II must be met as on the closing date and time for receipt of applications in CCI, that is 24 December 2026 (5:00 PM). The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications by CCI. For each post, the eligible services and the post or experience required come from Annexures I and II, as below. The pre-revised pay scales printed there are also given. Officers of the All India Services or Central Civil Services Group 'A' or Indian Economic Services or Autonomous Organisations or Regulatory Authorities or Universities or Academic or Research Institutions etc. having a Master's Degree in Economics and: working in an analogous post or grade; or four years' experience in the grade pay of Rs.8700 (revised Pay Level 13); or ten years in the grade pay of Rs. 7600 (revised Pay Level 12) or equivalent. Officers of the All India Services or Central Civil Services Group 'A'/ Autonomous Organisations/ Regulatory Authorities/ Universities/ Academic/ Research Institutions with one of the qualifications in the table above and: working in analogous posts/ grade; or six years in the grade pay of Rs.7600 (revised Pay Level 12); or ten years in the grade pay of Rs. 6600 (revised Pay Level 11) or equivalent. Officers from the All India Services/ Central Civil Services Group 'A'/ Indian Economics Service/ Indian Statistical Service/ Autonomous Organisations/ Regulatory Authorities/ Universities/ Academic/ Research Institutions etc. with a Master's Degree in Economics/ Statistics and: working in analogous post/ grade; or five years' service in the grade pay of Rs. 6600 or equivalent. Officers from the All India Services/ Central Civil Services Group 'A'/ Autonomous Organisations/ Regulatory Authorities/ Universities/ Academic/ Research Institutions etc. with one of the qualifications in the table above and: working in analogous post/ grade; or five years' service in the grade pay of Rs. 6600 or equivalent. Officers having a Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in any discipline from a recognised university and: working in analogous post/ grade; or five years' experience in the grade pay of Rs.5400 (revised Pay Level 10); or six years in the grade pay of Rs.4800 (revised Pay Level 8); or seven years in the grade pay of Rs.4600 (revised Pay Level 7); or ten years in the grade of Rs.4200 (revised Pay Level 6) or equivalent, in the relevant field (Establishment/ Personnel Management/ Secretarial Practices/ Administration). content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is on deputation on foreign service terms basis for three years, subject to satisfactory performance. It is governed by the instructions in DOPT OM No.6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended from time to time. It is also governed by GoI Notification No. GSR 670 (E) dated 14 September 2009, as amended from time to time, on the conditions of service of Officers and other employees of CCI. Apart from basic pay, the post carries DA, HRA and Transport Allowance etc. at the rates applicable to Central Government employees from time to time. The fixation of pay and deputation (duty) allowance is governed by instructions issued by DOP&T from time to time. Medical reimbursement is admissible as per the CCI service rules. This is in lieu of CGHS benefits, which are not admissible to the Officers of CCI. CCI is an eligible office for allotment or retention of Government accommodation from the General Pool.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 posts in total: 1 Director (Eco), 1 Joint Director (FA), 1 Deputy Director (Eco), 2 Deputy Director (FA), 1 Assistant Director (CS), 1 PPS, 3 Office Manager (CS) and 2 Office Manager (F&A). The vacancies are liable to change without notice.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Deputy Director (HR), CCI, New Delhi by 24 December 2026 (5:00 PM). Applications received after this will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the CCI deputation posts?
faq.answer: Employees of the All India Services, the Central Civil Services, or autonomous organisations, regulatory authorities, universities or academic or research institutions of the Central or State Governments can apply. Each must also meet the post-wise conditions in Annexures I and II.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The qualification depends on the post. The Director (Eco) needs a Master's Degree in Economics, the Deputy Director (Eco) a Master's Degree in Economics/ Statistics, and the FA posts a Master's Degree in Commerce, an MBA (Finance) or CA/CS/Cost and Works Accountant. The Assistant Director (CS) and Office Manager posts need a Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in any discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications by CCI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for CCI deputation posts?
faq.answer: The pay ranges from Level 10 (Rs.56100-177500) for Office Managers to Level 13A (Rs. 131100-216600) for the Director (Eco). DA, HRA and Transport Allowance etc. are paid on top of the basic pay at Central Government rates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-III pro-forma and have it forwarded through proper channel, with the Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance, Integrity Certificate and attested APARs for the last five years. Send it to the Deputy Director (HR), Competition Commission of India, 9th Floor, Office Block-1, Kidwai Nagar (East), New Delhi-110023.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates may be called for an interaction with the Selection Committee constituted for the post. The Committee will also assess each Curriculum Vitae with its supporting documents. No TA/DA is payable for the interaction.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CCI appointment permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on deputation on foreign service terms basis for a period of three years, subject to satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post in CCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. The application format says separate applications may be submitted for separate posts.
